curations.textual_observation: Acts narrates the Philippian jailer and the people of his household hearing the message and being baptized after Paul and Silas are freed.
curations.uncertainty: The jailer’s household is distinct from Lydia’s household in Acts 16; the passage does not establish either household as the location of every Philippian assembly.
curations.why: Acts narrates the Philippian jailer and the people of his household hearing the message and being baptized after Paul and Silas are freed. This passage-anchored explanation connects Household to Roman Philippi: Colonial, Civic, and Household Life in the authored direction while stating the limits of the evidence.
